svg.title: One estate: Home, agent runtime, vault, edge, Home MCP, RPC gateway and the estate chain, with people, applications and outside agents at the boundary

g.text: five Workers on faithnet.io hosts, the Home on Vercel
the only place a person signs
OAuth 2.1 AS · a relying app of Home
revoke a wire, never an identity
One deployment: these buildings, these names, this chain. A second estate is the same shape with other names.
